import re

def slugify(text):

    # Replace one or more non-alphanumeric characters (including spaces) with a single hyphen

print("Test 1:", repr(slugify("  a   b  ")))

print("After strip().lower():", repr(text))

print("After regex sub:", repr(result))
final = result.strip("-")
print("After strip('-):", repr(final))
